ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; high-intensity white pixels dominate the lateral lobe regions (approx. 65%), while low-intensity black pixels form a central wedge and fringe along the trailing edge (approx. 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized solid black pigmentation radiating from the notch into a bi-lobed 'butterfly' pattern; high-frequency mottling/stippling at the white-black interface; one prominent dark circular spot on the mid-left lobe and multiple smaller dark circular spots on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 25% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge; high-amplitude serrations present along the entire length; significant peaks and notches are most pronounced in the medial and distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge (partially submerged) with a trailing edge that follows a generally concave upward curve toward the tips, interrupted by significant topographic irregularity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, raised circular nodules (barnacles) localized exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical linear disruption (rake mark) visible in the lower-central white region of the left lobe; additional faint horizontal linear disruptions on the outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; distinct vertical scar/pigment break on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular dark pigment spot located on the far distal-upper quadrant of the right lobe, isolated from the central black mass.
